name: San Marino
official: Most Serene Republic of San Marino
system_note: Two Captains Regent serve jointly as heads of state for six months at a time.
snapshot: One of the world's oldest republics, a hilltop microstate inside Italy that has signed an association agreement with the EU.
leader: Two Captains Regent, replaced every six months
culture: San Marino claims to be the world's oldest surviving republic, founded in 301. Its three towers on Monte Titano are UNESCO-listed. Every six months, on 1 April and 1 October, two Captains Regent are installed as joint heads of state in medieval ceremony.
society: San Marino is surrounded by Italy and uses the euro. Tourism, banking and light industry support a high standard of living. Many Sammarinese work across the border. An association agreement with the EU was concluded to deepen access to the single market.
situation: San Marino is governed by a coalition led by the Christian Democrats. The Great and General Council elects the two Captains Regent every six months.
power: A parliamentary republic. The 60-member Great and General Council elects the government, the Congress of State, and every six months two Captains Regent who serve jointly as heads of state.

leaders.state: Two Captains Regent, elected every six months
leaders.gov: Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs Luca Beccari
